history.recommendation_text: The Board recommended that the Administration expand the roster of candidates to widen the sphere of competition for the selection of the consultants and individual contractors.
history.administration_response: As mentioned above, the Department of Economic and Social Affairs has deployed Inspira and the first consultancy job opening (number 113374) was posted in March 2019, with the process being successfully completed in April 2019. Three other job openings (numbers 118550, 118556 and 118557) are also currently posted in Inspira. Prior to that, starting in October 2018, the Department had also implemented mandatory use of the personal history profile in Inspira, and hence had started building and expanding the roster to widen the sphere of competition.
history.board_assessment: The Board notes the information provided by the Administration and will verify the status during its future audits. The recommendation is considered to be under implementation.

history.recommendation_text: The Board recommended that the Administration expand the roster of candidates to widen the sphere of competition for the selection of the consultants and individual contractors.
history.administration_response: The Administration requests closure of this recommendation as implemented. Rosters in Inspira for consultants have expanded over the years and access to Inspira by hiring managers has been granted to widen the pool of candidates suitable for their needs. Hiring managers are required to post job openings in Inspira for consultants and individual contractors who are needed for six months or more.
history.board_assessment: Given that the application of Inspira was in process, and individual cases within one year indicated that individual contractors might not have been selected through Inspira, the Board considers this recommendation to be under implementation.

history.sg_progress: Since October 2018, no consultants and individual contractors have been contracted without using Inspira to create their profiles. Hiring managers have been using the roster in Inspira when reviewing candidates for assignments, although not all consultants and individual contractors are selected through a job opening in Inspira. Section 4 of ST/AI/2013/4 provides that selection through a job opening in Inspira or electronic platform is mandatory only when services of a consultant and individual contractor are needed for more than six months. This requirement has been strictly enforced since March 2021. The Administration considers this recommendation to have been implemented and requests its closure by the Board.

history.recommendation_text: The Board recommended that the Administration expand the roster of candidates to widen the sphere of competition for the selection of consultants and individual contractors.
history.administration_response: Since October 2018, no consultants and individual contractors have been contracted without using Inspira to create their profiles. Hiring managers have been using the roster in Inspira when reviewing candidates for assignments, although not all consultants and individual contractors are selected through a job opening in Inspira. Section 4 of administrative instruction ST/AI/2013/4 provides that selection through a job opening in Inspira or electronic platform is mandatory only when services of a consultant and individual contractor are needed for more than six months. This requirement has been strictly enforced since March 2021. The Administration therefore considers this recommendation implemented and requests its closure.
history.board_assessment: Given that Inspira has been used and that the relevant requirement has been enforced, the Board considers this recommendation implemented.
